description_short: Among Er3+-based MOSLEDs, list host matrices that reach high external quantum efficiency (EQE ≥ 10%) and report their threshold voltage, annealing temperature, emission lifetime (τ), and operational device lifetime (OLT), sorted by lowest voltage and highest EQE.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

paper_context.table_description: Performance characteristics of Er3+-based MOSLED devices fabricated by ALD: annealing temperature, external quantum efficiency (EQE), power efficiency, threshold voltage (Vol), emission lifetime (τ), and operational device lifetime (OLT).

numeric_parsing.motivation: Table 5 contains heterogeneous textual entries, including units (e.g. "%", "V"), approximate signs ("≈"), and non-numeric placeholders such as "NG".
numeric_parsing.strategy: For each performance field (EQE, Vol, Ann. T, τ, OLT), the query first converts the cell value to a string and then strips all non-numeric characters (except digits, decimal point, and minus sign) using a regex, before casting to xsd:decimal.
numeric_parsing.missing_values: If no digit is present (e.g. "NG"), the corresponding numeric variable is left UNDEF, and BOUND() checks ensure that such rows are excluded from filters that require a numeric value.

filters.efficiency_filter: Rows are restricted to those with EQE ≥ 10% via FILTER(BOUND(?eqe_num) && ?eqe_num >= 10). This selects high-efficiency Er3+ MOSLEDs.
filters.voltage_filter: Rows must have a numeric threshold voltage via FILTER(BOUND(?vol_num)), ensuring that sorting by voltage is meaningful.
filters.domain_note: The comparison R1469991 specifically models Er3+-based MOSLED devices, so no additional dopant filter is required in the query.

postprocessing_notes.output_columns: The query returns host_matrix, eqe_num, vol_num, anneal_num, tau_num, and olt_num, ordered primarily by ascending voltage and secondarily by descending EQE.
postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The joined view over host matrix, EQE, threshold voltage, annealing temperature, emission lifetime (τ), and operational lifetime (OLT) supports multi-criteria assessment of MOSLED performance (efficiency, power consumption, thermal budget, and stability) without manual re-aggregation from the original table.
